name: @a-identity/trust-mcp

tools.name: price_quote
tools.description: Free. The live price of one A-Identity trust tool in USDC on Algorand, read from its x402 challenge. For agent_batch_audit, pass count to price a shortlist.

tools.name: pay_check
tools.description: Paid ($5 USDC on Algorand). Before paying an Algorand address: Looks safe, Be careful or Don't pay, with the reasons, its biggest payers (and whether they are linked to it), its last payments, and the wallet that created it. Takes an Algorand address or the link of an x402 seller.

address.description: The Algorand address you are about to pay, or the link of an x402 seller.

tools.name: risk_check
tools.description: Paid ($5 USDC on Algorand). Call BEFORE paying or hiring another agent: an ALLOW / WARN / DENY verdict on the counterparty with the reasons and signals behind it. Do not pay on DENY.

agentId.description: The agent to check: an ERC-8004 token id ("#849980"), a CAIP id, or an owner address.

amountUsd.description: What the payment you are about to make is worth, in USD. Sizes the verdict to the deal.

tools.name: verify_agent
tools.description: Paid ($1 USDC on Algorand). Whether the agent has an on-chain ERC-8004 identity, its KYA (Know Your Agent) status, and whether it has been revoked.

agentId.description: The agent to check: an ERC-8004 token id ("#849980"), a CAIP id, or an owner address.

tools.name: reputation_score
tools.description: Paid ($2 USDC on Algorand). A deterministic 0-1000 reputation with its breakdown, a Sybil signal, and the latest on-chain attestation of the score.

agentId.description: The agent to check: an ERC-8004 token id ("#849980"), a CAIP id, or an owner address.

tools.name: agent_passport
tools.description: Paid ($10 USDC on Algorand). Identity, KYA, reputation and the risk verdict for one agent in a single document.

agentId.description: The agent to check: an ERC-8004 token id ("#849980"), a CAIP id, or an owner address.

tools.name: agent_batch_audit
tools.description: Paid ($4 USDC per agent on Algorand, up to 50). Every verdict for a shortlist in one call, with a summary count. The whole audit is produced before the payment is submitted, so an audit that cannot finish costs nothing. Check the total with price_quote against your cap first.

amountUsd.description: What the payment you are about to make is worth, in USD. Sizes the verdict to the deal.
